title: GTA6 Developer Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Union Trial
description: The legal battle involving GTA6 developer Rockstar Games heats up as an HR manager claims he had little interest in employee unionization evidence.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Ongoing Union Trial Amid GTA6 Development

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the release of *GTA6* (Grand Theft Auto VI), developer Rockstar Games finds itself navigating legal challenges outside of the virtual world. The ongoing legal case of Rockstar Games vs Garland & Others has heated up, bringing internal labor practices into the spotlight.

### Key Testimony in the Union-Busting Trial

According to reports from media outlet Eurogamer, one of the witnesses in the ongoing proceedings is a Rockstar Games HR manager. During the testimony, the manager stated that he had "little interest" in evidence of unionisation efforts that had been sent to him by an anonymous employee. 

This testimony comes prior to the developer laying off a substantial number of union Discord members, a move that sparked significant controversy and led to the current legal battle regarding alleged union-busting practices within the studio.

### Broader Context for the Studio

While Rockstar focuses heavily on the final stages of *GTA6*, controversies surrounding workplace culture and labor relations continue to make headlines. Industry observers are closely watching the courtroom proceedings to see how the outcome might influence not only Rockstar's internal policies but potentially broader labor standards within the AAA gaming sector.

### Editor's Take

The testimony from Rockstar's HR manager adds a compelling layer to an already complex legal dispute. As the trial progresses, the final verdict will likely have significant implications for how major gaming studios handle employee organization and workplace rights moving forward.
